section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Limited Slip Differential
title: INSTALL CASE COVER BOLTS / CHECK SIDE GEAR THRUST CLEARANCE / INSTALLATION OF DIFFERENTIAL

content.description: Hand applying Lock-Tight compound to bolt threads using a bottle

items: (a) Apply retaining compound to the bolts.

content.text: Use Lock-Tight as the retaining compound.

items: Apply Lock-Tight Primer T to the case threads and the mounting bolts, and allow to dry thoroughly.
Apply Lock-Tight to the case threads and the bolts and install the bolts.
Allow to stand at least 3 hours after tightening the bolts. [In cold weather, heat to 30 — 50°C (86 — 122°F) before letting stand.]

content.description: Torque wrench being used to tighten bolts on differential case cover

content.text: (b) Tighten the bolts evenly and gradually.

content.description: Side gear being turned with shaft to check thrust clearance

content.text: Turn the side gear with side gear shaft or other means and check to see that they turn smoothly.

items: INSTALL DIFFERENTIAL CASE IN CARRIER (See page RA-30)
